column1: # The waiting list (SPEC-256, TF-012): tests that are written before what they test exists.
# Columns, separated by tabs: test, reason, words.
#   test    the test's whole name, as the level's report prints it
#   reason  "code" for code that Phase 5 has yet to write, "images" for images that have yet to be approved
#   words   words that the test's failure must contain
# A listed test is in order while it fails with those words. It is a fault when it fails otherwise, and
# when it passes: a test that starts to pass is taken off this list in the same change.
SPEC-203 every good fixture tune passes the check
SPEC-203 a tune that breaks any row of the table is refused with MSG_INVALID_SID
SPEC-203 the limits of the table are exact: 256 songs pass, a default song of 0 is read as 1
SPEC-203 a good tune cut short at any length is refused or passes, and never reads past its end
SPEC-203 SPEC-096 the header's fields are read as the fixture's header gives them
SPEC-098 SPEC-010 text from a tune's header is converted from Windows-1252, every printable character of it
SPEC-008 the MD5 function gives the test vectors of RFC 1321
SPEC-154 an HVSC path has HVSC's shape and alphabet and nothing else
SPEC-154 a collection path may have spaces and accents, and still no way out of the collection
